title: Fynaptix · AI Biotech Research
heading: AI Biotech Intelligence
subheading: AI-native drug discovery, computational biology & longevity capital
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Biotech carries binary clinical risk; AI-discovery names trade on platform narratives years ahead of any FDA approval.
footnote: Figures approximate, from public quote pages and news write-ups; many quote pages were cached, so prices are dated individually and are NOT all current. ILMN, TEM, NVDA/LLY (Nov 6) are the freshest; most other prices are Oct 23-26 closes, and NTLA/CRSP/IBB are Oct 27 intraday. Post-Oct 26 stock reactions for Guardant are reported inconsistently across sources (-5% to -12%). Schrödinger's Nov 4 Q3 results could not be retrieved and are not asserted. ARKG AUM, holdings and return figures are from Oct 21-26 quote pages; ARK trade data covers Nov 4-6 only. Exact Sciences (EXAS) was acquired by Abbott and delisted Mar 23, 2026. Refreshed weekly (Mondays). Always confirm current prices/valuations independently.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI Q3 REVENUE +23%; FY26 GUIDE RAISED TO $1.60B; FIRST QUARTER OF CLEARLY POSITIVE ADJUSTED EBITDA ($25.6M)
kpis.label: Tempus reported Nov 2: revenue $411.5M (+23%), diagnostics $303.5M (+20%, oncology volume +32%, MRD tests ~12,000), data & applications $108.1M (+33%), adjusted EBITDA $25.6M (vs $1.5M), net loss $14.9M (vs $80M), adjusted EPS $0.07 vs $0.01 consensus. FY26 revenue guidance rose to $1.60-1.605B; data-licensing bookings above $550M YTD. Shares were up roughly 4-8% pre-market (sources differ); last close found $72.22 (Oct 30). ARK bought TEM again Nov 5-6.

kpis.sub: GUARDANT Q3 REVENUE +36%, SHIELD 83K TESTS; FY26 GUIDE RAISED TO $1.36-1.37B BUT CASH-BURN GUIDE WIDENED; SHARES FELL
kpis.label: Guardant reported Nov 5 after the close: revenue ~$361M (+36%) vs ~$351M consensus; Shield revenue $67.6M (+180%) on 83,000 tests (66,000 in Q2), cost per test down to $330 from $410; oncology volume +58% but revenue only +25%. FY26 revenue guide raised to $1.36-1.37B, but free-cash-burn guidance widened to $205-220M (partly a CMS billing delay). GAAP net loss $124.4M. Shares fell roughly 5-12% depending on source from ~$168.58 pre-report.

kpis.sub: RECURSION Q3: REC-4881 FAP DATA POSITIVE, PRO FORMA CASH ~$749M, RUNWAY INTO 2029; SHARES -5% TO $3.83 ON NOV 2
kpis.label: Recursion (Nov 2): revenue $18.55M (mostly a $10M Sanofi milestone; nine-month revenue $32.7M is below last year's $39.1M), net loss $119.0M, EPS -$0.22 vs -$0.24. REC-4881 (FAP): nearly 50% of upper-GI patients had >=65% polyp-burden reduction at 12 weeks; registrational trial targeted 2H27 pending FDA feedback. REC-1245: 91.7% disease control (11/12) at >=45 mg. Cash $561.5M, ~$749M pro forma after the October offering. Still no approved drug.

kpis.sub: ARKG $48.72 (OCT 26 CLOSE, LATEST FOUND); 35 HOLDINGS, TOP-10 ~58% (OCT 21); 1-YEAR RETURN ~52.8%
kpis.label: ARKG: 0.75% expense ratio, AUM $2.02B, 35 holdings, top 10 at 57.77% (10x 8.65%, Twist 8.14%, Tempus 8.11%), trailing 1-year ~52.8% but roughly 8% a year since its Oct 31, 2014 inception (derived). Nov 4-6 trades: bought Tempus ($4.5M Nov 5, $0.95M Nov 6), Twist ($5.3M, $0.58M), Natera ($4.8M), Veracyte ($4.0M), small adds in IAM, WGS and SCTX; sold CareDx (~$14.8M across Nov 4-6), Personalis and Lilly ($7.7M Nov 5).

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic, and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Recursion's REC-4881 is a registrational plan (2H27), not an approval. Insilico's lead investigator puts rentosertib's approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's lonvo-z (PDUFA Mar 10, 2027) is gene editing rather than AI discovery; Barclays is Underweight ($8).

bear_case.title: Even good prints can be sold: Illumina -18.6% on a beat-and-raise
bear_case.description: ILMN beat and raised yet fell 18.64% to $235.99 (Oct 30) after a ~157% run-up; Guardant raised revenue guidance for the third time and still sold off 5-12% because cash-burn guidance widened to $205-220M. Good prints are not enough when positioning is crowded; Tempus' growth also slowed to +23% from +50% TTM.

bear_case.title: Platform value is unproven and dilution is the funding model
bear_case.description: Recursion raised $200M at $3.25 (Oct 15) and nine-month revenue is below last year; Generate ($13.06 vs $16 IPO) and Eikon ($5.54 vs $18) show IPO-window names fading without an approved drug. Platform proof still depends on a handful of early readouts.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and sub-scale proteomics
bear_case.description: Guardant's PTAB challenge to a core TwinStrand patent was rejected and the judgment appeal is open; Shield pricing (ASP >$800) is expected to drift lower and a CMS billing delay raised burn. Quantum-Si has TTM revenue of ~$1.6M (-53%) and no launch until Q2 2027.

bear_case.title: Rate and macro sensitivity: tech sell-offs spill into biotech
bear_case.description: NVIDIA fell on Nov 5 in its second-largest one-day loss and sits ~23% below its 52-week high; tech sell-offs have spilled into biotech tooling. XBI was $150.47 on Oct 26, below its $169.89 high. Lilly's strong quarter included ~15% price erosion, a reminder that policy and pricing risk sits in the large caps too.
